findings.text: PARSED_REVIEW_STATUS restates the "parsed" literal that the store's vocabulary owner declares at reckon/crew/review.py:840 (RECOGNISED_REVIEW_STATUSES), whose docstring states the set is public so a reader that selects reviews imports it rather than restating the vocabulary and drifting from it; the same selection rule is already encoded at reckon/crew/recovery_review_subject.py:1185. The node meets the earlier blocking finding by selecting on "parsed" alone, which is correct; what remains is that the actionable status is declared in three places rather than exported once from the owner. Non-blocking.

VERDICT goal: the goal is to classify an exited review run complete when its latest attempt filed a parsed filed review record; reckon/crew/recovery_classification.py:763 adds that branch and the six tests in tests/test_an_exited_review_with_a_filed_record_reads_complete.py drive it.
VERDICT done_when: the done_when names classify_pointer, three fixtures and the gate bundle; the manifest's after_suite records the bundle at 063134bda as 13 failed / 523 passed, and base-arm.log reproduces all 13 ids, so zero added failures.
VERDICT write_paths: the declared scope is reckon/crew/recovery_classification.py, the new test module and the evidence fragment; git diff b809b3ac..e9aae6d8 touches exactly those three files.
VERDICT manifest: read; status complete, commits e0d24b9a5..e9aae6d8e, after_suite recorded, negative_control_log named, and no baseline_suite key (this node is role implement, not an armed review).
VERDICT diff: read commit by commit; e0d24b9a5 adds the filed-record read, 39a8321c3 keys it on the attempt, 063134bda narrows the selection to the parsed status and answers the prior blocking finding, e9aae6d8 is the fragment-only docs commit.
CALL_SITES: reckon/crew/recovery_watch.py:311, reckon/crew/obligations.py:482, reckon/crew/promotion.py:384, reckon/crew/query.py:348, reckon/serve.py:884
SCORE goal_fidelity: 18
JUSTIFICATION goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/recovery_classification.py:763 reads promotable when an exited review's own attempt filed a parsed record, which is the goal; the attempt marker is used rather than the newest receipt, a stricter reading than the goal's "latest".
SCORE evidence: 15
JUSTIFICATION evidence: the after_suite bundle at 063134bda (13 failed / 523 passed) and base-arm.log together give zero added failures, but the base arm ran only the eight failing modules (73 tests) and the gate ran one fragment-only commit before the reviewed head e9aae6d8.
SCORE scope_discipline: 20
JUSTIFICATION scope_discipline: git diff --stat b809b3aca0f56665bf445a5056d4f88eb453e26d e9aae6d8ed0dc551500f477551846ce5538d4136 lists only recovery_classification.py, the new test module and the fragment, all inside the declared write paths.
SCORE durability: 18
JUSTIFICATION durability: the three arms in negative-control.log each redden a fixture the change protects (arms reddening tests/test_an_exited_review_with_a_filed_record_reads_complete.py:197, :221, :258 and :284), and no added assertion compares a value to the same input the test passed in.
SCORE fit: 16
JUSTIFICATION fit: PARSED_REVIEW_STATUS and _parsed_review_record at reckon/crew/recovery_classification.py:182-192 follow the module's underscore-prefixed helper style and carry no plan or ticket label.
SCORE reuse: 14
JUSTIFICATION reuse: _parsed_review_record does not fork a capability whole, but it restates the "parsed" literal that reckon/crew/review.py:840 owns and that PARSED_REVIEW_STATUS:182 re-declares, and the same selection rule already sits at reckon/crew/recovery_review_subject.py:1185.
FINDING reckon/crew/recovery_classification.py:182 non-blocking: PARSED_REVIEW_STATUS re-declares the "parsed" literal whose owner is reckon/crew/review.py:840 (RECOGNISED_REVIEW_STATUSES), and the same selection rule is encoded at reckon/crew/recovery_review_subject.py:1185, so the actionable status now lives in three places; the owner's docstring states its set is public so a reader that selects reviews imports it rather than restating the vocabulary. The node correctly selects on "parsed" alone and answers the earlier blocking finding; what remains is that the constant should be exported once from the owner. Non-blocking.
